{{Youmay|the type of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]|the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Interrogation Droid!|department]]}}
{{Quote|I am ''through'' asking, princess! Now... my little helper will do the asking!|Cronal|<ref name="Gambler's World">"[[Gambler's World]]"</ref>}}[[File:T0D-SSW.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[T0-D interrogation droid]], a model of interrogation droid.]]
An '''interrogation droid''', also known as a '''torture droid''' or '''pain droid''', was used as a [[Torture/Legends|torture]] device in coercive interrogations. Various varieties existed, equipped with various implements of torture. Sometimes, they were modified [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]]. While they were technically illegal, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] used one during the interrogation of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia Organa]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Reasons for use==
The alien and mechanical quality of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] could make it more frightening than an organic interrogator, which often aided the interrogation. A droid was also more capable of finely judging a subject's reactions to torture, and of applying various "treatments" precisely.

For the interrogator, using a droid was sometimes less troubling than performing the torture oneself. If the interrogator wished to assume a bargaining tone with the subject after the coercive phase, the use of a droid also helped redirect the subject's anger towards the droid, rather than the interrogator.

==Behind the scenes==
The classification of interrogation droids has been inconsistent among various sources; the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'' incorrectly labels them as [[Class two droid/Legends|class two]]&mdash;repair and maintenance&mdash;and classifies the [[BL-39 interrogator droid]] as a [[Class one droid/Legends|class one]] due to its medical basis. ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' lists the [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O interrogation droid]] in the [[Class four droid/Legends|class four]] section, as they are designed for inflicting pain.
